notes.title: Patch v13.04 (Sept 24) - Minor Changes, Balance Adjustments, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Debuff heroes can now use their skills on spawnkilled enemies, ensuring they get their skill usage off more often.
[*] If a hero's skill is active when he is removed from the map, the active skill timer will continue to decrease normally, rather than end instantly like before. This means the hero's skill can still be active if you quickly place him back on the map.
[*] Added overflow bonus for having over 100% ultra gold, exp, or energy chance. Every 1% over 100% counts as +5% towards the ultra amount (ultra critical hits already worked this way).
[*] Slightly rebalanced daily tasks and weekly missions, and added a few new ones for late game players.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a short delay between the Weekly Community Event ending and the new one beginning. This should fix issues with some people losing contribution progress from the few minutes immediately after the weekly reset.
[*] Added each hero's mastery level/progress to the side hero placement menu.
[*] Added more anti-cheat and auto-ban checks.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mastery exp is now calculated correctly when spawnkilling enemies. Previously, if you killed the enemy too fast, certain heroes with auras who required "kills within range" might not register the kill in time.
[*] Fixed a few bugs related to loading the tournament leaderboards.
[*] Fixed various other minor bugs and inconsistencies.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v12.44 (August 7) - New Combat Styles, Milestones, and Balance Changes
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Exp Factory combat style unlocked at rank 500.
[*] New Level Milestones unlocked at level 7,500.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Veteran’s rank 500 synergy from +250 flat exp to +20% boss exp.
[*] Ninja's Sneak Attack skill received a +20% damage buff.
[*] Elementalist's Confuse skill will now cancel out all slow/stun effects on an enemy while they are walking backwards, significantly increasing its effect. Any slow/stun effects will resume when the confusion skill ends.
[*] Chieftain's Ground Slam skill received a slight buff to its damage and a slight nerf to its slow effect (it shouldn't be as powerful as Apprentice's slow).
[*] Changed Instant Spell Cooldown chances to trigger after each individual use of the spell, rather than after each wave.
[*] Changed Instant Skill Cooldown chances to trigger after each individual use of the skill rather than after each wave.
[*] Reduced the max level of the Instant Skill Cooldown upgrade in the Weekly Tickets menu from 25 to 10. Also increased the cost of this upgrade from 50 to 75. Your current levels were automatically adjusted for this change in cost/max, and any remaining tickets were automatically refunded.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added several additional stats to the Global Breakdown section of the Stats menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug related to the start/end timing of the PvP Boss event.
[*] Fixed bug related to the enemies killed leaderboard stat.
[*] Fixed various minor UI bugs/inconsistencies.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v12.43 (July 28) - Balance Adjustments and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Progressive Rank Exp upgrade in the Tournament menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] In the Tournament upgrade menu, the cost of the +2 flat exp upgrade was reduced by 33%. Your levels were automatically adjusted (increased) to account for the lower cost.
[*] In the Weekly Tickets upgrade menu, the former +3 flat exp upgrade changed to +2 progressive exp. Since this is much more powerful, the cost increased from 10 to 30. Your levels were automatically adjusted (reduced) to account for the higher cost.
[*] Increased the max level of the Ultimus Min Spawn Wave automation workshop.
[*] Skills that hit multiple enemies can no longer trigger a splash effect on those extra enemy hits. Only the initial hit from the projectile on the targeted enemy can splash.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a server-side issue causing many players' Community Event scores to not get submitted. We were hitting some rate limits on the server, but this has been resolved.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v12.41 (July 18) - Balance Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased rune rewards from daily gifts to make them more meaningful at later stages of the game (the amount now scales off your highest wave).
[*] Rebalanced many of the Community Event milestone values, as well as your required personal contribution amounts to claim those rewards.
[*] Added the permanent stat bonuses from the Community Event rewards into the "Battlepass Rewards" section of the stats menu, and renamed this section to "Permanent Rewards".
[*] Increased cost of 2x PvP Boss rewards from 500 gems to 750 gems. The previous cost was simply too cheap for how many of these rare time-gated resources it gave you.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Boss Rush status is now saved between game sessions. If it was enabled before closing the game, it will remain enabled when you reopen it (but offline progress will still not use Boss Rush).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Chieftain and Apprentice’s combined skills would cancel out the slow effect if their Skill Power was too high.
[*] Fixed bug from the previous update that broke Assassin's execute skill.
[*] Fixed visual-only UI bug related to a maxed idle status workshop.
[*] Fixed bug where community milestone requirements were showing as complete right after a weekly reset, even though they weren't.
[*] Fixed bugs related to skill immunities against the PvP Immortal Boss and Ultimus Boss.
[*] Fixed bug where the PvP Immortal Boss scores weren’t updating correctly if you leaked a normal enemy.
[*] Fixed visual-only UI bug related to the PvP Immortal Boss 2x rewards.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v12.3 (June 9) - Weekly Community Boss Challenge!
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Community Weekly Boss Event! Team up with 50 other players to take down as many of this Ultra Boss as possible, and claim epic rewards at the end of each week!
[*] New upgrades in the Tournament and Weekly Ticket menus.
[*] Several new QoL Automation Workshops and Function settings, such as instant hero levels after prestige, toggles for  the Ultimus spawn wave and boss type, etc.
[*] New end-game challenges with epic rewards in the Missions > Challenges menu.
[*] Added an achievement for Supreme Shadow kills (this is a newly tracked stat, so you're all starting at 0 kills).
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased weekly ticket earnings in the weekly premium Promo Packs (to scale with the new ticket income from the weekly boss).
[*] Improved the Rune Packs in the store (bought with gems or $) to scale better and include Supreme Runes I and II when they are unlocked.
[*] Changed the F2P Battlepass reward for level 75+ from +15 runes to -75% Shadow/Alien HP reduction.
[*] Only Supreme I runes will be rewarded from Supreme Shadows killed between waves 10k and 20k. After wave 20k, there is a 50/50 chance that the runes rewarded will be Supreme I or II.
[*] Reduced the energy cost of unlocking Supreme heroes.
[*] Increased the Auto Boss function activation time (it was OP).
[*] Reduced Auto Boss bonus gold/exp from 15% to 10% per level.
[*] Increased the Auto Trainers function activation time.
[*] Increased the Auto Shadow function activation time (to encourage more manual spawns).
[*] Changed Auto Shadow bonus runes from +1 to +5% per level (slight nerf).
[*] Increased the Auto Alien function activation time (to encourage more manual spawns).
[*] Changed Auto Alien bonus tech scrolls from +1 to +5% per level (slight buff).
[*] The Auto Ultimus function can now only activate after wave 5k.
[*] The Auto Supreme function can now only activate after wave 10k.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the description of automation workshops to display both the total and new level effects.
[*] Various UI improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several crashes on Android related to the Vulkan graphics API.
[*] Added logic to save a backup of your data every 24 hours in case of data loss bugs or account issues.
[*] Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v12.25 (May 19) - QoL Impovements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a reset button for Automation Functions, so that you can repurchase them in a different order if you made a mistake.
[*] Added a rune rarity effects slider to give you better control over the rarity of runes you obtain.
[*] Increased the default FPS setting from 30 to 45 on mobile devices.
[*] Removed the "multiple devices detected" warning, since it was often incorrect.
[*] Improved the Discord advertisement for new players to make joining our awesome community more attractive.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs related to pausing during auto-prestige.
[*] Fixed various bugs related to synergies and skills while dragging and dropping heroes.
[*] Fixed visual bug and errors related to the leaderboards not loading.
[*] Fixed incorrect tournament tier notifications for Tiers 27 and above.
[*] Fixed visual bug where texts would not show the correct value for numbers greater than the "DT" value using the customer lettering format.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v12.23 (May 1) - New Upgrades, Supreme Rune Changes, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] 15 New Supreme Runes available after passing wave 20k.
[*] New Tournament menu upgrades to skip enemy HP increases after a completed wave and to increase the Supreme Shadow spawn chance.
[*] New Weekly Ticket menu upgrades to gain free hero levels after a completed wave and to increase the chance for 2x Supreme Runes drop from the Supreme Shadow boss.
[/list]

[b]General Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the color of the Ancient Shadow boss to better match the color of runes that he rewards.
[*] Changed the name of "Mini Shadow" to "Supreme Shadow" to better match his Supreme Runes reward.
[*] Capped Progressive Exp Supreme Runes at level 999. New powerful late game rank exp sources will be introduced in a later update.
[*] Added more Tournament Tiers after wave 30k, spaced out every 5k waves.
[/list]

[b]Supreme Boss/Runes/Shards Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Supreme Shards resource was completely removed. This was a useless and redundant middleman resource since it could only be used on one item.
[*] Any remaining Supreme Shards you had were automatically converted to the max affordable Supreme Runes.
[*] The Supreme Shadow boss now drops Supreme Runes upon death, just like the Ancient Shadow drops normal runes. It is more consistent and streamlined this way.
[*] The spawn rate of Supreme Shadows was significantly reduced, since every single kill now gives you a Supreme Rune (whereas it previously took dozens of kills to get one rune).
[*] The Technology upgrade that previously increased Supreme Shards drop was changed to increase the Supreme Boss spawn chance.
[*] For those of you who just reached wave 10k and unlocked Supreme Runes, you will get a significant bonus spawn rate on your first 100 Supreme Shadows to make up for the fact that your first few Supreme Runes were much cheaper back when the Shards resource was used.
[*] Automation workshops related to the Supreme Shadow were rebalanced (higher costs and cooldowns, and lower max levels) to maintain balance with all these other changes. If you were previously above the new max levels, you will be automatically set back to the new max. You may think this is unfair and you wasted time/resources, but actually it balances out because everyone else now has a much higher cost and upgrade time to deal with, whereas you are already done with the cheaper/shorter times (even if you went over the new max).
[*] In conclusion, this is a net positive change for everyone. The new formula should allow you to earn Supreme Runes nearly twice as fast as you previously did with the Shards resource.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Boss rush no longer automatically turns off when you fail a wave.
[*] Removed notification spam from extra boss spawns. This notification will now appear over the boss on the map when he spawns.
[*] Massive performance improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed memory leak causing enemies to become unkillable or stop spawning.
[*] Various other minor bug fixes and UI corrections.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v12.1 (April 19) - Future Proofing and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Apologies for the chaos around the past couple patches. There were some major changes around save data formats, data type changes, anti-cheat detectors, and many more complex things behind the scenes. A number of unexpected errors resulted from these complicated changes, which were causing loading issues, rollbacks of data, false-positive ban warnings, and more. Thankfully, I believe I've finally ironed out the last of the remaining bugs, and everything should be smooth and back to normal from now on. Thank you for your patience through this little rough patch!

[b]Backend:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed several data types in the game to support numbers larger than e308, meaning there is now tons of room for new multiplicative bonuses, bigger damage and gold numbers, and much higher waves :). The potential progress for this game is now practically infinite!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed all bugs related to cloud saving/loading.
[*] Fixed error preventing some Android users from loading the game.
[*] Fixed false-positive "injection" ban warning on Steam, preventing some new players from entering the game.
[*] Fixed memory leak bug causing the enemies to become unkillable or stop spawning while playing with 120 FPS or high quality settings.
[*] Fixed bug where some pop-up windows would grow larger and larger if closed and opened quickly.
[*] Unlocking new automation function/workshop slots now correctly adds to your gems spent challenges.
[*] Various other minor bug fixes and UI corrections.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v12.0 (April 17) - Critical Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug causing many accounts to trigger false-positive injection ban warnings, which also prevented new players from even starting the game. You don't have to worry if this triggered for you - your account wasn't actually flagged as a cheater or banned. It was a totally invalid trigger that you can ignore.

I am really sorry about this inconvenient bug! It had to do with the new data type conversions that the last update introduced. Everything should be back to normal now.

Please reach out to my on Discord if you are still experiencing issues after installing this update.

notes.title: Patch v11.71 (April 5)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The auto-prestige function will only work when you’re at a minimum of 20% of your highest wave (not just the map-specific highest wave). This will ensure you're not auto-prestiging at inefficient times on maps where you have a low wave, or if you leak enemies on a low wave for some reason.

[*] Changed automation workshop "cancel" buttons to "pause".

[*] If you log out/in to switch accounts via the settings menu, you'll be able to skip the tutorial instead of being forced to play through it again.

[*] Increased security around the leaderboards to keep cheaters off of it.
[*] TONS of improved anti-cheat and auto-ban logic. Good luck cheaters ;).

[*] Fixed bug where canceling a workshop upgrade immediately after purchasing it would require you to purchase it again, rather than let you continue it for free.

notes.title: Major Automation Update
notes.notes:

[list]

[*] Added two expensive end-game upgrades for Rank Exp (%) and Energy Income in the Prestige upgrade menu for a new Prestige resource sink.

[*] Improved the battery saver screen with tons of extra data.

[*] You can now close the video ad (active play) menu by clicking outside of it, like all other menus.
[*] Tons of new anti-cheat and auto-ban logic.
[/list]

[*] Various other minor bug and UI fixes.

notes.title: Update v11.6 (February 13)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced the Tournament menu's "Max Spell Level" upgrade with "Spell Duration" (your levels carry over, so you don't lose any resources). Having an upgrade increase the max level of something in a different menu was a bit weird, complicated, and not very user friendly. Now, everyone's spells can reach the new max level of 25 without any need for additional upgrades outside of the spells menu.
[*] Increased the max level of the "Spell Duration" upgrade in the Tournament menu from 5 to 7.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]

[*] Added settings to only show more specific combat texts (super/ultra procs).
[*] When opening the Battlepass menu, it will automatically scroll to the highest claimable reward.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]

[*] Various other minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.5 (February 3)
notes.notes:

[list]
[*] Unlock and set up Attribute Presets after passing wave 7500. These allow you to set up different Attribute levels for your heroes, and quickly switch between them for maximum efficiency.
[*] Pay gems to reroll wave perks. The gem cost increases after each reroll you use, but resets on each new prestige run.
[*] New Technology upgrades for free wave perk rerolls and Mini Shadow Supreme Shards.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Preview your hero presets on other maps by selecting the relevant button at the bottom of the presets menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v11.48 (January 25)
notes.notes:
This is just a minor patch that is mostly needed to change/update some important backend services that the game requires. A much larger update with new features like Attribute Presets, Wave Perk Rerolls, and maybe even two new maps will be released soon :).

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added different colors and sizes to the rank up notifications to differentiate between smaller and bigger gains.
[*] Added a setting to turn off splash damage.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where some players ended in the wrong tournament tier and couldn't claim their rewards.
[*] Fixed visual bug where the synergy bonus upgrade in the Tech menu was showing as unavailable.
[*] Fixed visual bug related to the "no skills" targeting setting.
[*] Corrected the wave perks availability text in battery saver mode.
[*] Various other minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v11.47 (January 16)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new synergy bonus upgrades to the Research and Technology upgrade menus.
[*] Added Tier 26 (wave 30k+) and Tier 27 (wave 32k+) tournament brackets.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the synergy bonus map perk on Desert. As synergy effects became more and more powerful in recent updates, this map perk became so out of balance and made all other maps irrelevant. Instead, a [u]more powerful[/u] synergy bonus is now available through the Research and Technology upgrade menus, which effects all maps equally. Therefore, this change is actually a huge buff - the effect is just achieved differently.
[*] Added extra Training Dummy spawns as a map perk on Desert (replaced the synergy bonus map perk). This should be seen as a huge buff, because now you can consistently get extra Dummy spawns beginning from wave 1 and without relying on RNG from wave perks. With high enough map perk upgrades, you can still achieve +2 Dummy spawns.
[*] Removed the extra Training Dummy spawns wave perk. Instead, you can now get extra Training Dummy spawns consistently by playing the Desert map. 
[*] Added bonus Ultimus Tokens to the potential wave perks pool (replaced the extra Training Dummy spawns wave perk). 
[*] Increased the max level of Map Perk upgrades in the Ultimus and Supreme Runes menus.
[*] Buffed the "Tycoon" combat style with higher kill gold % and an additional global range bonus.
[*] Changed the last few level milestones on Militia, Warlock, and Captain to include Ultra Energy Chance.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] When killing the Training Dummy, the new rank notifications will show the sum of all ranks gained for each hero, rather than just the last few, providing you much more useful information about the total gains.
[*] Added a 10k level mult option in the Research upgrade menu.
[*] Added more stats to the Stats menu, as well as a global breakdown of Combat Style bonuses.
[*] Added a link to the "New Player Guide" to the FAQ.
[*] Added some details about skill types (damage/resource/debuff) to the FAQ.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v11.46 (December 28)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added more Battlepass rewards up to level 75, with new rewards such as Weekly Tickets, Ultimus Tokens, and Supreme Runes (if you are at a high enough wave for them to be unlocked). Also increased the runes/gems repeat rewards after level 75, due to the higher level requirement.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a scaling rank requirement to the progressive exp upgrade in global hero attributes (you can upgrade 1 level per 20 ranks). This is meant to help spread out this powerful upgrade over time, and have it scale and always be meaningful as you continue to progress. If you previously leveled over the new rank requirement, your levels will be set back and you will automatically be refunded the attribute points spent on them.
[*] Buffed the energy income earned from purchasing leaderboard icons with gems.
[*] Buffed the kill exp earned from purchasing leaderboard icons with prestige power.
[*] Buffed tycoon style ultra gold amount from 10% to 12%.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v11.45 (December 24)
notes.notes:
This patch reverses most of the nerfs from yesterday's v11.4 update. I miscalculated some things, and those nerfs hit players at a certain stage of the game way harder than I intended. Sorry about that!

These changes should bring your overall power back close to where it was before yesterday's update, as well as significantly increase your exp gains to help you reach those new synergies and attributes quicker!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Buffed commander combat style from 3% to 4% synergy bonus.
[*] Buffed most of the earlier synergies back close to where they were pre-nerf (some are still slightly lower because I still believe they were too OP before and caused a snowball effect, hurting the later game balance). But they are at least very close to where they were before the last update.
[*] Buffed most of the level milestones. Some are even a lot higher than what they were before the last update, especially gold and crit dmg.
[*] Buffed Rank Exp I in the weekly tickets menu from +1 to +3 exp per level.
[*] Changed Rank Exp II in the weekly tickets menu from +40 exp to +1% exp per level (providing a significantly larger boost for most people).
[*] Changed Rank Exp II in the hero attributes menu from +2 exp per level to +1 "Progressive Rank Exp" per level, which very quickly becomes insanely more powerful than the old value.
[*] Added a minimize button to the new Premium Battlepass/Daily Gifts microtransaction pop up.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.4 (December 23)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New level milestones at levels 5000 and 6000.
[*] New synergies at ranks 500, 1000, and 1500.
[*] New combat styles at ranks 750 and 1250.
[/list]
 
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced several synergy bonuses. Some were getting out of control and ruining the balance of other upgrades throughout the game. Some were nerfed, some were buffed.
[*] Slightly reduced the synergy bonus in the "Commander" combat style.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 2 more hero preset slots.
[*] You can now "stockpile" the repeatable battlepass rewards at level 61+, so that you never miss one if you gain multiple levels without claiming the reward.
[*] Click a synergy in the selected hero menu to minimize it and reduce scrolling.
[*] Added more accurate details to the progressive rank exp info text.
[*] When playing on 1x game speed, the wave perk game speed effect will also be disabled.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.34 (December 17)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Supreme Rank Exp Rune was changed to "Progressive Rank Exp". The exp now increases with each new rune you discover. For example, rune #1 gives +10 exp, rune #2 gives +12 exp, rune #3 gives +14 exp … rune #25 gives +58 exp … etc. This way it scales better with your progress to always be useful.
[*] The Rank Exp upgrade in the Gems menu was also changed to "Progressive Rank Exp" to make it more worth the gem cost in mid/late game. To prevent it from being too OP too early in the game, it is wave locked at certain thresholds. 
[*] Buffed all energy skills and spells to use a percentage of energy income to calculate their effects, which is much higher than the original flat amounts by mid/late game. The flat amounts also remained to remain relevant for early game players. This may require another buff in the future, but it is at least better than before.
[*] Achieving more than 100% super gold chance now overflows into bonus super gold amount (+5% amount for every 1% chance over 100%). Now all super chances (crit, gold, exp, and energy) work this way with overflow chance over 100%.
[*] Offline progress now includes your average crit chance and damage (including super and ultra) in the DPS calculation to determine the max wave you can reach while offline.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Veteran’s skill now correctly adds Super Exp Amount when it pushes the Super Exp Chance over 100%.
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.33 (December 9)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]More Attributes:[/u] Added several new mid-late game Rank Attributes to heroes (both personal and global). Heroes who are rank 450+ will get a free attribute respec to make use of these new upgrades.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the max level cap on Rank Exp II global attribute (previously maxed at level 25).
[*] Achieving more than 100% super exp/energy chance now converts each 1% chance over 100% into 5% super exp/energy amount (same way that critical hit chance overflow works).
[*] Permanent super/ultra energy upgrades now affect the energy gains from the Power Mage ultra boss (only permanent upgrades you spent resources to unlock - not synergies or map perks). This can potentially increase this boss's energy rewards by A LOT for some players. 
[*] Map Perks and Wave Perks no longer affect rewards or resource packs (Resource Packs, Rune Packs, Battlepass Rewards, Daily Gift Rewards, etc). These perks are temporary and are too RNG-based and inconsistent to be fairly calculated into these reward packs. Some player's rewards may slightly decrease due to this change.
[*] Scaled down prestige daily task requirements for mid/late game players. It was very tedious and time consuming to do 10 prestiges per day at a very high wave.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a "Reward Scaling" section in the stats menu that shows your current and best tracked hourly stats (excluding all temporary effects). This will help you determine if you’re nearing a new record value, which would increase all your rewards from Resource Packs, Battlepass, and Daily Gifts.
[*] Made the Wave Perk bar slightly bigger and more noticeable when a new perk is available to claim.
[*] The game will now auto-claim all of your available remaining Battlepass rewards right before the monthly reset, so nothing will be lost.
[*] If the "hide maxed upgrades" toggle is selected in a menu, it will also hide the headers of all fully maxed sections of upgrades.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies with how map perks, wave perks, and events were affecting the stats menu. Now, all of these bonuses are included in the stats menu calculations, whereas previously some stats included them, and others did not.
[*] Removed hotkey texts from mobile platforms.
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.3 (November 28)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Wave Perks:[/u] Unlocked at wave 5000. With this new mechanic, you gain a new temporary boost for the current run after every 2000 waves. You will be given a selection of three boosts to choose from. The bonuses from these temporary boosts stack, but are reset when you prestige.
[*] [u]Supreme Runes:[/u] Unlocked at wave 10000. Purchase these with the new "Rune Shards" resource. Rune Shards are earned by killing the new "Mini Shadow" boss, which has a small chance to spawn on every wave after 10000. Higher waves have a higher spawn chance.
[*] [u]New Upgrades:[/u] Added several new mid-late game upgrades for almost every resource type.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now stockpile Ultimus spawns for more efficient spawning strategies. The base cooldown for an Ultimus spawn was reduced from 8 hours to 3 hours. However, you only gain 1 spawn per cooldown now, rather than all 3 Ultimus spawns like before. Now you can choose which boss type to use your spawns on. There are new upgrades to increase the maximum number of spawns you can stockpile.
[*] Updated prices of some upgrades in the tournament menu. They all used to have a low price cap, making everything (even the late-game upgrades) relatively cheap. That cap was raised, so some upgrades are now slightly more expensive. 
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a 120 FPS toggle to the advanced settings menu. This may help players who leak easy waves due to the game not being able to keep up with super fast game speeds (ex: 6x speed + max Time Warp spell). Warning: this setting may drain your battery and heat up your device.
[*] Minor performance improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few potential sources of the bug where enemies get stuck and stop spawning. Fingers crossed!
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v11.21 (November 16)
notes.notes:
Most of the big new content that was announced (robots, supreme runes, evolving spells, etc.) is still in the works, as these are huge new mechanics that require a ton of new UI and testing. So, unfortunately, today's update isn't anything too exciting yet - mostly just bug fixes. I've also been spending a ton of time on marketing and improving the App Store pages to increase the game's player base, community, and growth. A growing game is a successful game!

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Not that the majority of you would ever notice (which is a good thing), but a ton of new functionality was added to the "Fix Me" button to help me resolve the majority of tickets and bug reports quickly and efficiently, ensuring you can get back to playing the game right away without any issues holding you back.
[*] Updated the App Store pages and marketing content to attract more players.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the synergy menu was showing the wrong rank for some heroes.
[*] Fixed bug where the "Efficiency Bundle" was being promoted to players who already had game speed maxed as F2P.
[*] Fixed bug related to offline gains.
[*] Various minor UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.2 (November 6)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a list of "Starter Tasks" to give new players some basic direction toward their first upgrades, heroes, synergies, etc. Completing these tasks gives small rewards to help boost the new player's early progress.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the exp required for battlepass levels after level 75 (to balance things better with new battlepass upgrades and rewards coming in the near future).
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added text showing an upgrade’s max level in the "details" pop-up when you click on it.
[*] The synergy menu now shows each hero’s current rank, rather than the required rank. The required rank is already displayed elsewhere in the menu, so it was redundant to show on top of each hero icon.
[*] Improved the new player tutorial. 
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]

[*] Fixed rare bug related to shadow/alien hp reduction.
[*] Fixed rare bug related to offline gains.

[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.1 (October 21)
notes.notes:
Since the last few updates were geared more towards extending the late-game content, this one was more focused on improving the early game for new players.

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New and improved tutorial that guides new players through changing combat styles and activating their first synergy.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Synergies now require ALL heroes, including the selected hero, to have the required rank to satisfy the synergy. Previously, the selected hero ignored all rank requirements, and only the other heroes in the synergy had to meet the rank requirements. That is no longer the case.
[*] The synergy menu UI changed slightly to reflect the above changes. You will now see the selected hero included in the synergy formula, including his rank and if he meets the requirements or not.
[*] Changed some of the Tier 1 synergies on a few of the common and uncommon heroes.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Synergy explanation guide.
[*] More notification icons to guide new players in various menus throughout the game.
[*] Option to hide the Ultimus Token gem packs.
[*] Increased the FPS for Steam players on the low quality setting.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug related to enemy targeting.
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v11.0 (October 14)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New upgrades in the Prestige menu unlocked at wave 10k.
[*] New upgrades in the Ultimus menu unlocked at wave 10k and 15k.

[/list]

[list]

[*] The 'Gem Bonus' event (+50% gems in the store and +50% gems from daily tasks) now automatically occurs every other weekend, rather than being part of the normal event rotation.

[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor bug and UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v10.9 (October 1)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Instant Skill Cooldown Chance" is now rolled independently for each hero on the field. Previously, only one hero could receive an instant skill cooldown after passing a wave. But now, multiple heroes (potentially all 10 if you're lucky!) can have their skills instantly cooled down at the end of a wave.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Significant[/i] performance improvements were made across all aspects of the game. I hope everyone's PC fans and mobile devices enjoy the reduced workload!
[*] Added x100 and "spend 50% gold" level mult options for upgrading heroes.
[*] Added a toggle for the "Instant Spell Cooldown Chance" effect in the settings menu.
[*] Added the game's current version number to the bottom of the settings menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where reaching your highest tournament wave while playing offline would prevent you from being able to claim the rewards at the end of the week.
[*] Various minor UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v10.7 (September 24)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]New Upgrades:[/u] Two new upgrades can be found in various menus to make killing Ancient Shadows and Exotic Aliens much easier! These upgrades reduce how much their HP scales up after each kill, and also improves the effect of spending gems to reduce their HP.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Raised the max tournament tier to 25. Beginning after wave 20k (tier 21), tiers are spaced 2000 waves apart, rather than 1000 waves.
[*] Reduced the effect of the "Hero Upgrade Cost" upgrade in the Weekly Tickets menu from 1% per level to 0.5% per level. This upgrade was simply too overpowered for its cost.
[*] Slightly reduced the Map Specialist weekly task requirements.
[*] Slightly reduced the Hero Specialist weekly task requirements.
[*] Slightly reduced the Synergy Specialist weekly task requirements.
[*] For players who don't have "ultra" chances unlocked yet, Tier 3 of the crit/gold/exp/energy tasks now require more "super" chances to complete, rather than the unobtainable ultra chances.
[*] Added x1000 upgrade option to the Research menu.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Click a leaderboard background challenge to get a better preview of how the background looks.
[*] Increased the visibility of your own score in the leaderboards with bolder borders and texts.
[*] If the enemy speed setting is turned off, it will now show 0% enemy speed effect in the stats menu.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the public player profile menu could expand to cover the whole screen.
[*] Fixed the best tournament stat in public profiles.
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to go into negative gems.
[*] Fixed bug where the instant "Skill Refreshed" text could appear on top of UI menus.
[*] Fixed bug where weekly tasks might not get initialized correctly without a network connection.
[*] Fixed bug where some players were being rewarded zero trophies from the tournament.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v10.5 (September 16)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Weekly Tasks: Completing these challenges will reward a new golden ticket resource, which can be used on a new set of unique upgrades. Challenges are automatically refreshed every Monday at 00:00 UTC, so complete them as fast as you can!
[*] Weekly Promo Pack: A new powerful promo pack that rewards tournament points and golden tickets is available to purchase once per week.
[*] Leaderboard Flair: Unlock and equip dozens of icons and backgrounds to customize how you appear on the leaderboards. Unlocking these also reward permanent stat bonuses (including some new unique upgrades)!
[*] View Other Player Info: Click on a player in the leaderboards to view some fun stats for that player.
[*] Tower Lives: There are new upgrades available that increase the number of lives you have, meaning you can leak more than 1 enemy without instantly failing the wave.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] New setting to display the number of active synergies for each hero on the field.
[*] Significantly improved the save/load logic to speed things up and prevent data loss when switching between devices.
[*] Improved long description of upgrades when clicking on one in any upgrade menu.
[*] Reduced clutter for new players by hiding certain buttons and features that are not available for them yet.
[*] Implemented several improved anti-cheat measures.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug preventing some players from claiming their tournament rewards.
[*] Added a button to cancel a purchase on Steam if it gets stuck on the loading screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v10.2 (July 23)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Heroes” menu button in the bottom left now opens a separate full screen detailed menu to view hero details. You can also quickly access this menu by double clicking on an active hero, or by selecting the “Details” tab in his individual upgrades menu.
[*] New late-game rank attributes for super/ultra bonuses. Any heroes currently above rank 90 will be able to reset their attributes for free one time (instead of paying 50 gems) to make better use of these new attributes (which unlock at rank 100).
[*] Added Gold VI upgrade to the Prestige upgrades menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked Lava Dungeon map to have a better path and perks.
[*] Reworked Sunny Farm map to support better and quicker farming layouts.
[*] Reduced Desert map synergy perk from 10% to 5%.
[*] Significantly increased all super and ultra synergy values to make their effects more worthwhile.
[*] Increased the base reward of the Ultimus boss from 1 to 5 tokens. This makes him more worthwhile to spend energy to spawn even at lower waves when he is first unlocked.
[*] Lowered the cost of spawning the Ultimus boss. The cost begins at 250k at wave 5000 and gradually increases until it maxes at 1m cost to spawn at wave 10k+. This way, the cost scales with the reward, and is more affordable for players who just unlocked him at wave 5000.
[*] Changed "Stand Ground" targeting option to “No Skill Usage”. This, in combination with Skill Support, is the same as the former Stand Ground stance, but allows more customization.
[*] The 2x bonus for first gem purchases now resets every month.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] New “Global Breakdown” section in the stats menu to display your stat bonuses from sources that frequently change, such as synergies, milestones, attributes, etc.
[*] Added total active synergies into the current run stats menu.
[*] Added a UI scaler adjustment in the settings menu. This is particular useful for PC players with large monitors. The setting is saved separately between PC/Mobile, so the UI won't get too big/small when switching back and forth between platforms.
[*] Moved the battery saver button back into an easy-to-access location in settings menu.
[*] Smoothed some menu transition animations.
[*] Improved the resource text priority (size and colors).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare bug where the tournament can reward 0 tournament trophies.
[*] Fixed bug with rank exp attribute not applying correctly.
[*] Fixed bug where the skill cooldown/active slider under heroes was sometimes the wrong color.
[*] Tons of minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Ultimus Boss! Update v10.0 (July 8)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New "Ultimus" Ultra Boss! He drops a new "Token" resource that can be used on a variety of upgrades, including the new Ultra Crit/Gold/Exp/Energy upgrades.
[*] Two new tiers of end-game challenges to complete for huge permanent bonuses.
[*] Most achievements extended up to 20 stars (reward remains at 50 gems, though).
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned a lot of the UI for a more clear and polished look.
[*] Added a new Power Mage energy upgrade to the tournament menu.
[*] Reduced the 25m killcount challenge to 10m kills.
[*] New hero targeting option “Stand Ground” to not attack at all, including skill usage.
[*] Added 2 more hero preset slots.
[*] Added 2 more spell preset slots.
[*] Adjusted the visibility of damage and resource texts so that higher numbers typically display on top of lower ones, and last longer.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Option to hide max upgrades in menus to reduce scrolling.
[*] Quick-Remove all heroes button.
[*] Hotkeys to quickly change hero presets (Ctrl+1,2,3,etc).
[*] Hotkeys to quickly change spell presets (Shift+1,2,3,etc).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug with the synergy bonus from the Commander combat style.
[*] Countless minor bug fixes.
[/olist]

notes.title: Supreme Heroes! Update v9.9 (June 24)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Supreme (tier 7) heroes!
[*] New level milestones at levels 3000, 3500, and 4000.
[*] New hero synergies at ranks 100, 150, and 250.
[*] Ultra crit chance and crit damage.
[*] Ultra gold/exp/energy chance and amounts.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Overflow 100% crit chance converts into crit damage (1% crit chance = 5% crit dmg) (previously converted to super crit chance).
[*] Changed the level milestones for many heroes at levels 1500, 2000, and 2500.
[*] Slightly increased the max level for some crit chance and super crit chance upgrades.
[*] Cost of super crit chance and damage in the Gems menu was reduced from 350 to 250. You were automatically refunded 100 extra gems you spent on each of these levels before this update.
[*] Changed the name of "bonus gold/exp/energy" to "super gold/exp/energy" for more consistent terminology.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a “make default preset” checkbox to automatically load a specific preset after each prestige.
[*] Improved main stats menu and hero stats menu with new stats and colors for better readability.
[*] Rearranged a few menus to reduce scrolling.
[*] Reduced damage/gold/exp text size a bit so they don't cover the screen as much.
[*] Added a "New Player Tips" section to the FAQ.
[*] Add some other additional info to the FAQ.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where synergy bonuses would not update correctly in a very rare circumstance.
[*] Various minor bug fixes or UI improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v9.8 (June 17)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added permanent multiplicative upgrades for Damage, Gold, and Prestige Power, and permanent additive upgrades for Rank Exp, into the Battlepass rewards menu. These are permanent and persist between seasons.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Battlepass, Daily Gifts, and Resource Pack rewards now scale based on your [u]best[/u] hourly resource gains (excluding ads, events, and ultra bosses), rather than on your highest wave like before. I recommend you do a new gold and energy farming run to synchronize these newly tracked hourly stats before claiming any of these rewards. The rewards should increase for almost everyone after a fresh new run.
[*] Offline progress now scales based on your [u]current run[/u] hourly resource gains (excluding ads, events, and epic bosses). It should be much more accurate and rewarding than before in most cases.
[*] The highest wave daily mission scales down as you reach higher waves.
[*] Enemy shields will repeat less often.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] The active play bonus button moves over to remain visible when the hero menu is open.
[*] Added battlepass exp, exp per hour, and permanent upgrade totals to the stats menu.
[*] Hotkey [tab] to quickly enter ultra low power mode.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies with the “kills from skills” mission.
[*] Fixed Champion’s skill from hitting the 3x stun limit immediately by re-stunning the same few targets over and over again.
[*] Fixed tons of minor bugs and UI issues.
[/list]

-----

[*] Two new tiers of end-game challenges for huge new upgrades.

notes.notes:

[list]

notes.title: Update v9.40 (May 20)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Several new combat style options for higher ranked heroes.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the level 3000 milestone down to 2500.
[*] Slightly changed a few of the older combat styles.

All your tag and support towers will now be able to fire off their skills immediately, even when spawn killing, without any of it going to waste. You shouldn't need to play with your range sliders so much anymore, and it should increase all your resource/per hour gains pretty significantly.
[*] Click on any hero icon in the synergy menu to switch to that hero’s menu for quick reference to compare synergy bonuses.
[*] Map bonus effects now effect your stats displayed in the stats menu (they were ignored previously).
[*] Added button in the spell preset menu to link back to the spell upgrade menu.
[*] When opening the Battlepass, Daily Gift, Achievement, or Challenge menus, it will auto-scroll to the first claimable reward (if one is available).

[list]

[*] Fixed bug where Battle Mage's skill and the Precision spell were not recalculating super crit chance correctly.
[*] Fixed various minor bugs related to map perks, the stats menu, and resource pack rewards.
[*] Fixed countless little UI bugs or inconsistencies.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v9.31 (May 6)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced cost of the Max Boss Rush Wave upgrade in the Tournament upgrade menu. You will automatically be refunded the difference of how much you already spent on this upgrade before the price reduction.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the “Sign Out” of your cloud save account functionality. You can now easily sign in and out between multiple accounts and profiles, even on the same device.
[*] Added info to the in-game FAQ for how to reset your game (simply use the Sign Out of cloud save button).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Battlepass “Claim All” button not always functioning correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v9.3 (May 4)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New upgrade to increase max boss rush wave in the Tournament upgrades menu.
[*] New upgrade to increase Tournament Trophy rewards in the Gem upgrades menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced Economist combat style from +25% to +15% exp bonus.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added hero and spell preset buttons to the main game screen.
[*] Added a claim all button for Battlepass rewards.
[*] Added a warning message to notify you if you have the game open on two devices at the same time (which could cause data loss).
[*] Reduced file size and improved performance.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved projectile logic to handle higher game speeds better (for example when the Time Warp spell is active).
[/list]
